build.title: How your file
build.description: Four steps, all free. Each one adds evidence employers can trust.
build.caption: Sample profile, for illustration

steps.title: Create your profile
steps.body: Add your experience, current and expected CTC, and notice period.

steps.title: Upload your resume
steps.body: AI analyses it and suggests roles that fit, or you add your own.

steps.title: Take up to 3 AI interviews
steps.body: Role-based interviews in the LetsHyre desktop app, whenever it suits you.

steps.title: Get your scorecard and get found
steps.body: Every interview produces a skill scorecard, and employers hiring for your roles can find you for 90 days.

prepare.title: Four kinds
prepare.description: Interviews mix these depending on the role. Read the guide before you start, so nothing on the day is new.

types.title: Multiple choice
types.body: Pick the best answer. Some questions use pseudocode.

types.title: Coding
types.body: Solve a problem in the code editor, for technical roles.

types.title: Written
types.body: Type a short answer that explains your thinking.

types.title: Spoken
types.body: Answer out loud, as you would in a real interview.

seen.title: You see
seen.description: Your scorecard carries the same scores employers read, with your strengths and the areas to improve.

timeline.title: In front of employers for 90 days
timeline.body: Your profile stays in the talent pool for 90 days after your interview, so the people who find you are hiring now.

items.q: Does LetsHyre cost anything for professionals?
items.a: No. LetsHyre is free for professionals. Employers pay with credits only when they unlock a candidate.

items.q: How many interviews can I take?
items.a: Up to three, for three different roles or more than one attempt at the same role.

items.q: Where do I take the interview?
items.a: In the LetsHyre desktop app, at a time that suits you. Download it before you start.

items.q: What do employers see about me?
items.a: Your scores, job match, skill match, experience and notice period. Your resume, contact details, documents, scorecard and recording are shared only when an employer unlocks your profile.

items.q: Why does my profile last 90 days?
items.a: So employers see people who are actively looking. Your profile stays in the talent pool for 90 days after your interview.

final.title: Show what you can do,
final.description: Create your profile, take your first AI interview and let employers hiring for your role find you.
